topic: Lite bound: window open uses hard-coded MAX_FILES
lesson: forge mode lite records max_files from quickfix.py MAX_FILES (5) regardless of harness.yaml modes.lite.bound, while forge fix validates the window against the config bound; changing the config to 6 wedges every new lite window ('does not match modes.lite bound'). Keep harness.yaml modes.lite.bound equal to MAX_FILES until symphony-forge reads the bound from config in _open.
